changeSet.createView: SELECT li.stage, so.observed_at::DATE AS process_date, count(*) FILTER (WHERE so.outcome LIKE 'BUSINESS%') AS business_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE so.outcome = 'TECH_FAILED') AS tech_failed_count, count(*) AS total FROM public.stage_outcome so JOIN public.launch_intent li ON li.id = so.intent_id WHERE current_user IN ('rpt_internal', 'root') GROUP BY li.stage, so.observed_at::DATE

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT li.stage, fa.client_token AS client, fa.arrived_at, so.observed_at, so.observed_at - fa.arrived_at AS arrival_to_outcome FROM public.file_arrival fa JOIN public.launch_intent li ON li.arrival_id = fa.id JOIN public.stage_outcome so ON so.intent_id = li.id WHERE current_user IN ('rpt_internal', 'root')

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.sql: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA rpt TO rpt_internal;
